auditFocus: an Eloquent create/update fed straight from $request->all() instead of validated() or an explicit $fillable/$guarded allowlist -- mass-assignment risk
raw SQL string interpolation (DB::select/DB::statement with concatenated values) instead of parameter bindings or the query builder/Eloquent
a relationship accessed inside a loop with no eager load (with()/load()) on the collection it iterates -- N+1 queries
Blade {!! !!} unescaped output rendering a value that traces back to user input
a state-changing route (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) missing CSRF protection or excluded from the VerifyCsrfToken middleware without a stated reason
a queue job with no idempotency handling (unique(), a dedupe key, or a check before side-effecting work) on a connection that can redeliver or retry it -- true of most production queue configurations
buildCommands: php artisan config:clear (when config/env-dependent errors appear)
./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse (when the project has a phpstan/larastan config)
fixGuardrails: Never silence a static-analysis finding with a blanket @phpstan-ignore or @psalm-suppress instead of fixing the root cause.
Never widen $fillable to a blanket guard-nothing allowlist, or swap $guarded to [] to make a mass-assignment error disappear.
Never disable CSRF verification for a route or add it to VerifyCsrfToken's except list just to make a failing request succeed.
Never delete or skip a failing test to reach a green build.
